item.title: Bloomington faces severe drought as lake levels drop
item.description: The city of Bloomington is monitoring lake levels and encouraging residents and businesses to conserve water due to a winter drought, after water levels at Lake Bloomington and Evergreen Lake reached a 10-foot deficit threshold.

item.title: Peoria business shows support for wounded deputy with signs and decals
item.description: CJ Signs in Peoria has created signs and decals in support of Sheriff's Deputy Jack Evans, who was critically wounded in a shootout last weekend, to help rally community support.

item.title: Peoria road closure planned for sidewalk and pavement removal
item.description: The intersection of West Antoinette Street and South Madison Park Terrace in Peoria will be closed on Monday for sidewalk and pavement removal as part of the Combined Sewer Overflow Year 4 Control Project, with detours available on South Western Avenue and West Marquette Street.

item.title: Peoria woman sentenced to 45 years for deadly Phillips 66 stabbing
item.description: Cathy Logan was sentenced to 45 years in prison for the first-degree murder of Tanazisha Green, after a judge considered Logan's rough life but noted the evidence from the gas station surveillance footage.

item.title: Local nonprofit holds annual Puppy Bowl in Normal
item.description: Pet Central Helps will hold its annual Puppy Bowl in Normal on Sunday, Feb. 8, featuring the Seattle Puphawks and the New England Puptriots, with pups up for adoption, raffle baskets, a craft table, a bake sale, and more.

item.title: Darin LaHood secures funding for Metamora public safety building
item.description: Rep. Darin LaHood secured $4 million in federal funding for a new public safety building in Metamora, which will house the volunteer fire department, police department, and emergency medical services, and will cost a total of nearly $11 million.

item.title: Dunlap High School students take part in mock election to learn voting process
item.description: Students at Dunlap High School participated in a mock election organized by the League of Women Voters of Greater Peoria, the Peoria County Election Commission, and civics teacher Ty Martin, to gain hands-on experience with the voting process and encourage long-term civic participation.

item.title: Teacher wins $50,000 classroom makeover in KI Furniture contest
item.description: Andy Goveia, a 7th and 8th grade social studies teacher at Thomas Metcalf School, received a $50,000 classroom makeover after winning a vote for the KI Furniture contest with 23,000 votes from the community.

item.title: Steven Rice promoted to brigadier general during Illinois Air National Guard ceremony in Peoria
item.description: Steven Rice was promoted to brigadier general during a ceremony at the 182nd Airlift Wing in Peoria, and was appointed as Assistant Adjutant General for Air with the Illinois National Guard, overseeing plans, programs, and readiness for nearly 3,000 airmen statewide.

item.title: Multiple people hospitalized after Peoria crash
item.description: The Peoria Fire Department responded to a two-vehicle crash that sent several people to the hospital on Friday, with injuries ranging from minor to critical.
